single_cube_turntable.name: Hand wheel / one cube turntable
single_cube_turntable.label: Hand wheel / one cube turntable
single_cube_turntable.description: Turn a compact 1.10-metre platform carrying one centered off-white cube. Hand input, speed and direction rotate the cube in place with its plate. Black steel, pink grips and the shared machine finish.
single_cube_turntable.qfep_connection: A centered body changes orientation without changing its position. The visible platform and cube share one transformation.
interactions: Drag the pink wheel or grip it in XR.
RPM sets 0..30; ANGLE pauses and places a phase.
RUN and REVERSE control automatic rotation.

parameters.auto_run: The motor yields to a held wheel and resumes after release.
